form.label: Setup
form.description: Store the TypeSafe API key for the | jev command, run the self-test, and try the three question types.

div.p: Create a key at console.typesafe.ai. It is stored encrypted in Splunk's credential store (storage/passwords, realm jev_for_splunk, user typesafe_api_key) and read by | jev with the searching user's own session. Only roles that hold list_storage_passwords can run the command; saving needs admin_all_objects.

Runs | jevtest live=true: Python, vendored SDK, configuration, every installed battery, the stored key, connectivity to TypeSafe (one tiny paid request), the jev_cache KV store collection, and which app answers | jev.
Every answer becomes a field. The three types return different shapes:

ul.li:
noul: the probability that a statement is true. Its sum over events is an expected count.
| makeresults | eval message="My 20% code showed in the basket but I paid full price" | jev noul message "The customer says they were charged more than they should have been" as overcharged

choice: one of your options, with a confidence.
... | jev choice message "Which part of the shop is this about?" options="pricing: prices and discounts; delivery: shipping and tracking; other" as area

score: a position on levels you describe, lowest first.
... | jev score message "How upset is the customer?" levels="Calm question; Annoyed; Angry" as upset

div.p: Answers are cached per question in the KV store, so running a search again only pays for new events. Add dryrun=true to preview tokens and cost. Do not use backticks inside a question: Splunk expands them as macros.
